added_neutral: Asks for a warm, skimmable tone for Etsy shoppers
Says to use plain prose only, with no headings, bullets or title
Assigns the first paragraph to introducing the mug and its appeal, and the second to care instructions
Suggests framing the mug as appealing to use or to give as a gift
